trigger: initial T3 screen had median gradient_max_abs 0.112 and all 110 folds exceeded 0.01
allowed_change: initialize retained-station raw effects from same-fold training residual means, then rerun the identical joint objective
probe_decision: if 1 Adam + 2 LBFGS remains above gradient 0.01, use the Stage3 3 Adam + 6 LBFGS schedule for every refined fold

registered_refinement_schedule.site_initialization: same-fold training residual mean by retained station
registered_refinement_schedule.v_f_profile: locked anchor plus/minus 0.05 profile clipped to [0,0.5]

refined_fold_gate: every fold gradient_max_abs <= 0.005; otherwise the refined screen is optimizer_confounded and cannot make a scientific promotion decision

round1_early_stop.reason: all completed folds exceeded 0.005, so the registered round could no longer yield an optimizer-valid screen

reference_equivalent_round_registered_be.motivation: the locked MINERAL_LIFETIME nested reference used temporal-fold process/site warm starts and 35 LBFGS iterations; candidate comparisons must receive the same numerical treatment
reference_equivalent_round_registered_be.process_start: same temporal fold O0_LOG_T4 parameters from 20260831_3
reference_equivalent_round_registered_be.site_start: same temporal fold O0_LOG_T4 station effects from 20260831_3, restricted to retained training stations

efficiency_probe_registered_before_resul.optimizer: same warm starts and objective, LBFGS max_iter 12
efficiency_probe_registered_before_resul.decision: use 12 iterations for all folds only if gradient_max_abs <= 0.005; otherwise retain 35

final_efficiency_probe_registered_before.optimizer: same warm starts and objective, LBFGS max_iter 8
final_efficiency_probe_registered_before.decision: use 8 iterations for all folds only if gradient_max_abs <= 0.005; otherwise use the already validated 12 iterations

final_bulk_schedule_lock.site_start: matching temporal-fold O0_LOG_T4 raw site effects for retained stations
final_bulk_schedule_lock.v_f_profile: temporal selected v_f plus/minus 0.05 clipped to [0,0.5]

adaptive_convergence_topup_registered_af.trigger_evidence: one of four folds had gradient 0.005402 after 8 iterations; no prediction metric was used
adaptive_convergence_topup_registered_af.rule: at the final selected v_f, add LBFGS in blocks of 4 only while gradient_max_abs > 0.005
adaptive_convergence_topup_registered_af.failure_status: optimizer_confounded if still above 0.005 after 20 final-v_f iterations
adaptive_convergence_topup_registered_af.invalid_partial_folds: recomputed; completed folds meeting the gradient target remain checkpointed

reference_rescue_registered_before_spati.trigger: after all 110 folds, only T3_LORO_R213 remained above 0.005 at 0.00601928
reference_rescue_registered_before_spati.optimizer: original reference-equivalent 35 LBFGS schedule already validated on the preregistered R002 probe
reference_rescue_registered_before_spati.replacement_policy: save separately and replace only the same fold during final combination; preserve the 20-step evidence
